description: Detect repeated cursors, duplicate-only pages and no progress in a pagination scan — Takes the pages an agent has fetched so far (cursor used, next cursor returned, item ids) and finds the failures that make a scan loop or lie: a next cursor already used, a page whose items were all seen before, a page that returned nothing new yet offers another cursor, a scan that has not ended. Optionally takes declared ordering and cursor assumptions and lists the omission risks they imply (of

mutatedDuringScan.description: Whether items may have been inserted or deleted while paging.

cursor.description: Cursor used to request this page; omit for the first page.

items.description: Stable item ids on this page, in returned order.

nextCursor.description: Cursor returned for the next page; omit or empty when the API reports no more.

name: pagination-loop
